usageNotes: Converts an existing LXC container into a template, allowing it to be cloned for rapid deployment of new containers. The container must be stopped before conversion — running containers cannot be templated. The operation is synchronous (returns null, not a UPID) and is irreversible; once converted, the container is no longer a deployable instance.

examples.summary: Convert LXC 200 on node pve1 into a reusable template

tips: Stop the container before calling this endpoint — Proxmox will reject the request if the container is running.
Conversion is one-way: there is no API call to revert a template back to a regular container.
After conversion, clone this template using POST /nodes/{node}/lxc/{vmid}/clone to spin up new instances.
Templates are visible in the Proxmox UI with a distinct icon and cannot be started directly.
